_comment: Provider-neutral uptime-monitor configuration STUB for the SYNAPSE Core API (E7.5).
This file documents the intended monitor; it is not applied automatically. Creating the
external account and the alert channels is a human step (E7-H). Map these fields to your
provider (UptimeRobot, Better Stack / Better Uptime, Checkly, Pingdom, Grafana Cloud, ...).
No secret belongs in this file.

alerting._comment_channels: Create these in the provider; put no real addresses/tokens here.

degraded_state: The API also answers 200 with status 'degraded' when the database is unreachable.
The keyword '"status": "ok"' deliberately treats 'degraded' as a failure so a DB
outage alerts, while a transient non-200 is caught by the status-code check.
deeper_check: This monitor is a shallow liveness probe. The functional check (guest session, a guest
build and the relay) is the scheduled GitHub Action tools/live-smoke.py (E7.3).
notes.shutdown: Pause or delete this monitor after judging (2027-01-29). See docs/runbook.md.
